messages:
Leah Morrison: Heads-up 1: a subset of new onboarding customers experienced partial webhook failures during tenant import between 04:00-04:25 GMT. Need a concise external note + enterprise escalation play.
Diego Alvarez: I'll draft. Include what happened, immediate workaround (manual retry), assurance about no data loss, ETA for backlog processing, and a goodwill credit. Keep it two short paragraphs.
Priya Menon: Workaround: `Console > Imports > Retry` or API: `POST /v1/imports/:id/retry`. Logs show retries are queuing; this is a processing backlog, not delete.
Omar Haddad: Infra note: rolling patch applied at 04:32 GMT. notify-bot: rollback protection enabled.
notify-bot: infra-bot: patch-rollout-455 applied at 2025-05-02T04:32:10Z, progress: nodes updated 8/8, status: success.
Diego Alvarez: Draft outbound: `Hi 1, we identified a partial webhook delivery failure affecting some tenant imports created 04:00-04:25 GMT. Engineers deployed a patch and are processing the backlog; we expect full catch-up within ~2.5 hours. If you need immediate access, retry the import in the Console (Console > Imports > Retry) or via API: POST /v1/imports/:id/retry. No customer data was deleted or exposed. As a courtesy we will apply a one-time credit equal to one day of ingestion fees and offer a complimentary 1:1 onboarding check-in to affected customers. Reply "check-in" to opt in or book: https://cal.redwood.com/1:1-onboard. For urgent issues email cs@redwood.ai.`
Leah Morrison: Swap "book" link to short link and include feedback capture after send. Also flag renewal-risk tenants so AMs can follow up.
Priya Menon: I'll export impacted tenant list and tag AMs. Also confirming credits queue.
Omar Haddad: Post-patch metrics: retry success rate up 95%, backlog drain rate increased 3x. Projected finish 06:55 GMT.
Diego Alvarez: Sending Intercom now to the affected segment; will paste campaign id and final copy once live.
notify-bot: intercom-bot: campaign-created id=IC-20250502-11 by Diego Alvarez.
Diego Alvarez: Outbound sent (IC-20250502-11). Final copy below for record: "Hi 1 024, we discovered a partial webhook delivery issue affecting imports created 04:00-04:25 GMT. A patch was deployed and processing is underway; we expect full completion within ~2.5 hours. To get immediate access to newly imported data, retry the import in Console > Imports > Retry or via API POST /v1/imports/:id/retry. No customer data was deleted or exposed. We'll apply a one-time ingestion credit (one day) and offer a complimentary 1:1 onboarding check-in. Reply 'check-in' or book: https://cal.redwood.com/1:1-onboard. For urgent help contact cs@redwood.ai"
Leah Morrison: Good. Owners: Diego send, Priya impacted list & AM flags, Omar confirm credits & final ETA, Nora capture feedback results. Close when credits posted + feedback summary.
Nora Kim: I'll stand up a 15-min office hour for anyone who opts into the check-in and capture opt-ins in the tenant-health doc.
Priya Menon: Impacted renewal cohort flagged and AMs notified. Credits queued for posting; will confirm when posted.
Omar Haddad: Confirmed backlog cleared at 2025-05-02T06:52:10Z; credits posted to billing queue. Final projection met.
Nora Kim: Early feedback (first hour): 12 opted into check-in, feedback survey: 22 Yes / 3 No. Adding results to tenant-health/2025-05-imports.
Leah Morrison: Thanks team. Please paste any final outreach summaries here and we'll close the thread.
